clade_law: Choose a retained tree uniformly, then a nonroot internal node uniformly. Count-vector multiplicities retained; not a per-tree presence probability.
interpretation: Descriptive empirical marginal comparisons only. High-dimensional topology support can be disjoint even under well-mixed draws. Within-individual allele swaps are quotiented; other individuals/populations stay distinct. Clade vectors intentionally lose topology information. Neither TV nor overlap certifies convergence or identifies the likelihood discrepancy cause.
